name: @pipeworx/mcp-usda-fdc

tools.name: search_foods
tools.description: Search USDA Food Data Central for food items by name, brand, or ingredient. Supports filtering by data type (Branded, Foundation, SR Legacy, Survey FNDDS, Experimental) and brand owner. Returns FDC id, description, data type, and publication date per result.

data_type.description: Filter to data type(s). Comma-sep. Options: Branded | Foundation | Survey (FNDDS) | SR Legacy | Experimental

tools.name: get_food
tools.description: Full food record by FDC id.

nutrients.description: Comma-sep nutrient numbers to restrict response

data_type.description: Filter to data type(s). Options: Branded | Foundation | Survey (FNDDS) | SR Legacy | Experimental

tools.name: nutrients_for_food
tools.description: Convenience: nutrient values only for a food.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-usda-fdc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the usda-fdc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
